svg.title: Compare Sub-Niches on Publisher Revenue per 1,000 Sessions
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-subniche-publisher-revenue-yields; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Sub-Niches on Publisher Revenue per 1,000 Sessions; subtitle: Equal traffic allocations produce a $49 blended publisher yield.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative yields, not market benchmarks. Allocate 2,000,000 annual sessions to each of five sub-niches: 10,000,000 sessions total. All yield components are USD of operator revenue per 1,000 sessions, after affiliate reversals. Equal traffic weighting produces $49 blended yield and $490,000 annual Base revenue.; caption: Across the five equal-traffic segments, advertising contributes $218,000, affiliate commissions $212,000, and sponsorships $60,000. Yield comparisons require consistent session definitions and periods.; stages: label: Home workshop references; value: $30 earned per 1,000 eligible sessions; numeric value: 30.0; detail: $18 advertising plus $10 affiliate commissions plus $2 sponsorship equals $30. At 2,000,000 annual sessions, publisher revenue is $60,000; original photos reduce rights risk.; label: Outdoor equipment guides; value: $40 earned per 1,000 eligible sessions; numeric value: 40.0; detail: $20 advertising plus $15 affiliate commissions plus $5 sponsorship equals $40. At 2,000,000 annual sessions, publisher revenue is $80,000; monitor seasonal traffic concentration.; label: Creative software tutorials; value: $50 earned per 1,000 eligible sessions; numeric value: 50.0; detail: $22 advertising plus $23 affiliate commissions plus $5 sponsorship equals $50. At 2,000,000 annual sessions, publisher revenue is $100,000; refresh screenshots after interface changes.; label: Small-business workflow guides; value: $60 earned per 1,000 eligible sessions; numeric value: 60.0; detail: $24 advertising plus $28 affiliate commissions plus $8 sponsorship equals $60. At 2,000,000 annual sessions, publisher revenue is $120,000; verify affiliate attribution windows.; label: Specialist software comparisons; value: $65 earned per 1,000 eligible sessions; numeric value: 65.0; detail: $25 advertising plus $30 affiliate commissions plus $10 sponsorship equals $65. At 2,000,000 annual sessions, publisher revenue is $130,000; monitor partner concentration and reversals.
